column1: # Pronunciation audio of this site: one row per file.
# Human recordings come from Wikimedia Commons (including Lingua Libre) under the licence named on each row. Every one was modified: trimmed, loudness-normalised and converted to MP3 (mono, 32 kbps).
# A modified CC BY-SA recording is shared under the same licence as its original (the licence on its row); a modified CC BY recording under its CC BY licence.
# Generated files use the Piper en_US-ljspeech-high voice (public domain; trained on the public-domain LJ Speech dataset).
